procedural_matters: POL 224926 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: Incidentoccurred in race #1 on the 3rd leg.
POL 224926 and GER 224876 approaching the leeward gate overlapped with POL 224926 inside.
Whenrounding the port mark, they were to leeward of the mark with POL 224926 oneboat width from the mark. GER 224876 was about the same distance from POL 224926.
Directlydownwind from the mark POL 224926 capsized and the mast of POL 224926 landed onthe deck forward of the mast on GER 224876.
Boatsgot entangled and both boats were not enable to continue until POL 224926 rightedthe boat.
conclusions: POL 224926, the windward boat, failed to keep clear of GER 224876 the leeward boatand broke RRS 11. POL 224926 was sailing within the mark-room to which she wasentitled and is exonerated by 43.1(b).

It was reasonably possible for POL 224926 to avoid contact with another boat. POL 224926 broke RRS 14(a). POL 224926 was sailing within the mark-room to whichshe was entitled and is exonerated by 43.1(c).
It was not reasonably possible for GER 224876, the right-of-way boat, to avoidcontact with POL 224926 when it was clear that POL 224926 was not keeping clear. GER 224876 did not break RRS 14.
the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
decision: The protest is dismissed. Redress is not given.
